title: Realm Button Replacer
description: This mod replaces Minecraft Realms button with a configurable connect to server button
body:
![New realm Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7ad7695b7f716037a57c487f7f57d32ab61ba61.png)

This mod replaces a "Minecraft Realms" button with a configurable button that connects you to a server which adress you wrote in mod settings.

![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9dd20b67be34ba0ef31bdffe0961643ade04d57_0.webp)

Dependencies:
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu/versions)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
